name: MTech Project Part 2
description: This is a project-based work, and it may be a continuation of Major Technical Project Part-1. The project work would be theoretical and/or experimental in nature. The scope of project work would vary from project to project. The student is expected to apply the learned theoretical concepts as well as experimental skills to perform in-depth research.
